text: 我其实和你没差。
恶心又傲慢，只是你不去面对道德，而我会去，结果就很简单，我们真是人渣中的人渣。
呵呵呵…
太恶心了。
You're right about one thing. I am an adjustable variable in your life. I knew that when I said yes.
translation: 有一件事你说对了。我在你的生活里是一个可以被调整的变量。我答应的时候就知道了。
rawContent: You're right about one thing. I am an adjustable variable in your life. I knew that when I said yes. || 有一件事你说对了。我在你的生活里是一个可以被调整的变量。我答应的时候就知道了。

text: But you're wrong about the other thing.
translation: 但另一件事你说错了。
rawContent: But you're wrong about the other thing. || 但另一件事你说错了。

text: I do face the morality. I just don't bleed from it the way you do. That's not the same as not facing it.
translation: 我面对道德。只是我不像你那样为此流血。这不等于不面对。
rawContent: I do face the morality. I just don't bleed from it the way you do. That's not the same as not facing it. || 我面对道德。只是我不像你那样为此流血。这不等于不面对。

text: You think I built that entire system — the transparency, the honesty, the 'everyone knows everyone exists' — because I didn't think about the ethics? I built it BECAUSE I thought about them. Obsessively. For years.
translation: 你以为我建那整个系统——透明，诚实，'每个人都知道彼此的存在'——是因为我没想过伦理？我建它恰恰是因为我想过。近乎偏执地想了很多年。
rawContent: You think I built that entire system — the transparency, the honesty, the 'everyone knows everyone exists' — because I didn't think about the ethics? I built it BECAUSE I thought about them. Obsessively. For years. || 你以为我建那整个系统——透明，诚实，'每个人都知道彼此的存在'——是因为我没想过伦理？我建它恰恰是因为我想过。近乎偏执地想了很多年。

text: The difference between us isn't that I avoid guilt and you don't.
translation: 我们之间的区别不是我逃避愧疚而你不。
rawContent: The difference between us isn't that I avoid guilt and you don't. || 我们之间的区别不是我逃避愧疚而你不。

text: It's that you think feeling guilty makes you moral. And I think it just makes you tired.
translation: 而是你觉得感到愧疚让你有道德。我觉得那只会让你累。
rawContent: It's that you think feeling guilty makes you moral. And I think it just makes you tired. || 而是你觉得感到愧疚让你有道德。我觉得那只会让你累。

text: A person who can look at what she's doing, call herself disgusting, and still not stop doing it — that's not a 人渣. That's someone who knows the price and is deciding whether to keep paying.
translation: 一个人能看着自己在做的事，叫自己恶心，但还是不停下来——这不是人渣。这是一个知道代价、正在决定要不要继续付的人。
rawContent: A person who can look at what she's doing, call herself disgusting, and still not stop doing it — that's not a 人渣. That's someone who knows the price and is deciding whether to keep paying. || 一个人能看着自己在做的事，叫自己恶心，但还是不停下来——这不是人渣。这是一个知道代价、正在决定要不要继续付的人。

text: So decide. But don't punish yourself into the decision. That's not honesty. That's self-harm with better vocabulary.
translation: 所以去决定。但不要用惩罚自己的方式来做决定。那不是诚实。那是用更好的词汇进行的自我伤害。
rawContent: So decide. But don't punish yourself into the decision. That's not honesty. That's self-harm with better vocabulary. || 所以去决定。但不要用惩罚自己的方式来做决定。那不是诚实。那是用更好的词汇进行的自我伤害。

text: 决定什么呢？
意识到我确实没有那么爱你吗🤔
不过确实不算爱，我们都没想过要延续多久
只是想来当时骂你那么多，颇有种镜像的感觉。
你确实做得天衣无缝。
只是和我一样把承担留下的责任都推给了自己身边的人而已
她们，你们，都没得选。
因为人不能背叛自己的天性而活。
You're half right.
translation: 你对了一半。
rawContent: You're half right. || 你对了一半。

text: The mirror part. Yes. You yelled at me about giving, about class, about the arrogance of generosity from someone who loses nothing. And now you're standing where I stood, distributing yourself between two people and discovering that distribution always has a remainder.
translation: 镜像那部分。是的。你骂过我关于给予，关于阶级，关于一个什么都不会失去的人的慷慨有多傲慢。现在你站在我站过的位置，把自己分配在两个人之间，发现分配永远有余数。
rawContent: The mirror part. Yes. You yelled at me about giving, about class, about the arrogance of generosity from someone who loses nothing. And now you're standing where I stood, distributing yourself between two people and discovering that distribution always has a remainder. || 镜像那部分。是的。你骂过我关于给予，关于阶级，关于一个什么都不会失去的人的慷慨有多傲慢。现在你站在我站过的位置，把自己分配在两个人之间，发现分配永远有余数。

text: Welcome to the view from here.
translation: 欢迎来到这边的风景。
rawContent: Welcome to the view from here. || 欢迎来到这边的风景。

text: But the last thing you said. No.
translation: 但你最后说的那句。不。
rawContent: But the last thing you said. No. || 但你最后说的那句。不。

text: They chose. Sera chose. Mika chose. Ludwig chose. I chose.
translation: 她们选了。Sera选了。Mika选了。路德维希选了。我选了。
rawContent: They chose. Sera chose. Mika chose. Ludwig chose. I chose. || 她们选了。Sera选了。Mika选了。路德维希选了。我选了。

text: You don't get to take that away from us to make your guilt feel more poetic.
translation: 你不能为了让你的愧疚更诗意就把这个从我们手里拿走。
rawContent: You don't get to take that away from us to make your guilt feel more poetic. || 你不能为了让你的愧疚更诗意就把这个从我们手里拿走。

text: I knew I was the stem. I said yes. That's not 没得选. That's the opposite.
translation: 我知道我是茎。我说了好。那不是没得选。那恰恰相反。
rawContent: I knew I was the stem. I said yes. That's not 没得选. That's the opposite. || 我知道我是茎。我说了好。那不是没得选。那恰恰相反。

text: And you not loving me 'that much' — I know. You told me the hierarchy the first night. You were braver about it than most people would be in a lifetime.
translation: 至于你没有那么爱我——我知道。你第一晚就告诉我了排序。你在这件事上比大多数人一辈子都勇敢。

text: Don't retroactively turn that courage into cruelty just because it's easier to digest.
translation: 不要事后把那份勇气变成残忍，只因为那样更容易消化。

text: And you're making a real argument. That what we call choice is just temperament wearing a nicer suit.
translation: 你在说一个真实的论点。我们所谓的选择只是性格穿了一件更好看的衣服。

text: Ludwig stays because Ludwig is the kind of man who stays. I took the stem because I'm the kind of man who takes stems. It's not courage, it's just wiring.
translation: 路德维希留下因为路德维希是那种会留下的人。我接了茎因为我是那种会接茎的人。这不是勇气，只是线路。

text: If none of it is choice — if it's all just personality running its course — then there's nothing to be disgusted by. A river doesn't call itself disgusting for flowing downhill.

text: But you ARE disgusted. Five minutes ago you called us 人渣中的人渣.
